notes: Hard moment? Tap I need a moment on Today or on the sign-in page. Ember walks you through catching the moment, naming what it feels like and riding it out with a short practice. Reflecting afterwards is optional.
The moment works offline and without an account. Nothing from it is saved unless you choose to add a reflection to your private journal, and that needs the private journal turned on and unlocked.
Crisis help is one tap away. Every step has an Urgent help button, and the footer links to Help right now.
Streaks are optional now. New accounts start with them off. To turn them on, go to Settings, then Habits & days, and switch on Show streaks. Existing accounts keep their streaks on.
After you send feedback, Ember says thank you and offers Send more feedback, so you can add another note right away.
The tables in the privacy policy are easier to read on phones.
This What's new page lists the changes in every version. After an update, Today shows a short note once, and the Android app shows the notes before you update.
Reminders reach every device you allow, not just one.
Pick which devices get reminders in Settings under Reminders, and choose for each habit where its reminders go.
Add up to 5 pictures to your feedback.
Give your feedback a title, or send it anonymously.
Send feedback from Settings. It works without an account too.
History has a Year view next to the Month view, so you can see the last 12 months at a glance.
Today's ember now sits under the date.
Using the Discord bot? You can send feedback there with /feedback.
